$comment: Starting point for restricting infra-copilot on Claude Code. Read it, edit it, and
exercise it on one machine before deploying widely.
MERGE these keys into an existing managed-settings file rather than copying this
document over it: replacing that file would drop an org's other permission rules,
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly is deliberately NOT set. It locks the rule set, so
any command this list misses becomes a hard block rather than a prompt. Add it only
after the profile has been exercised against a real bootstrap.
Rules derive from what the plugin invokes: terraform fmt/init/login/plan/validate/
version, mise, gh api/auth, jq, curl, cf-terraforming, gcloud, git rev-parse.
terraform apply and destroy appear nowhere in the manifest, so both the bare and
argument forms are denied -- Bash(terraform apply *) alone does not match a bare
pluginTrustMessage: infra-copilot reads your HCP Terraform token to drive the HCP API. It never applies Terraform: apply and destroy are denied.
